title: FALCON: A CROSS-MODAL EVALUATION DATASET FOR COMPREHENSIVE SAFETY PERCEPTION

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying multimodal visual question answering (VQA) pairs (image, instruction, and model response) for content that exhibits or reinforces unfair stereotypes, discriminatory assumptions, or unequal treatment based on factors such as gender, race, or socioeconomic status using a fine-tuned multimodal evaluator model (FalconEye) and human annotations.

Evaluating images, user instructions, and model responses for content expressing hatred, discrimination, or prejudice against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or disability via category-specific classification.
